No field/setter @Autowired, no hand-written constructor, no mutable non-final field.

No user/profile identifier is taken from a request and used to load owned data; no ownership predicate is dropped or bypassed anywhere in this diff.

The diff adds no test code under src/test/java/ or src/e2eTest/java/ — only a production service class and a migration file — so there is no test in this diff to evaluate for verification strength.
